{% call section("introduction", "Introduction", heading=false) %}

If you want a fixed floating action button, you can add multiple actions that appear on hover. The live demo is in the bottom-right corner of the page.

Wrap a large extra circle small (or circle extra) and a list of smaller ones in fixed-action-btn. That class pins the control to the corner. The menu opens on hover when the pointer can hover; add click-to-toggle to toggle on click. AutoInit() starts every matching element except those marked no-autoinit. Motion is CSS.

The IIFE bundle exposes Expressive.FloatingActionButton. Call init yourself when you need options other than the defaults, or let Expressive.AutoInit() start every .fixed-action-btn with the defaults below.

{% call code() %} document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { const elems = document.querySelectorAll('.fixed-action-btn'); const instances = Expressive.FloatingActionButton.init(elems, { // specify options here }); }); {% endcall %}

Per-instance options can also be passed through AutoInit:

{% call code() %} Expressive.AutoInit(document.body, { FloatingActionButton: { direction: 'top' } }); {% endcall %} {% endcall %} {% call section("options", "Options") %} {% call options_table() %} direction String 'top' Direction the menu opens. One of 'top', 'right', 'bottom', or 'left'. Write direction-left (etc.) on the element, or pass this option — the constructor stamps the class. hoverEnabled Boolean true When true, the menu opens on hover (CSS). When false, it toggles on click. .click-to-toggle is the markup switch. toolbarEnabled Boolean false Expand the FAB into a toolbar on click. .toolbar is the markup switch. See FAB to Toolbar. {% endcall %} {% endcall %} {% call section("methods", "Methods") %} {{ instance_note("FloatingActionButton") }}
.open();

{% call code() %} instance.open(); {% endcall %}
.close();

{% call code() %} instance.close(); {% endcall %}
.destroy();

Destroy the plugin instance and tear down its event handlers.

{% call code() %} instance.destroy(); {% endcall %} {% endcall %} {% call section("properties", "Properties") %} {% call properties_table("The DOM element the plugin was initialized with.") %} isOpen Boolean Describes the open/close state of the FAB. {% endcall %} {% endcall %} {% call section("horizontal", "Horizontal", heading="Horizontal FAB") %}

Creating a horizontal FAB is easy. Set the direction option to 'left' or 'right'.

Add direction-left or direction-right on the wrapper. The JS direction option stamps the same class.

To disable hover and toggle the menu when the large button is clicked — useful on touch devices — add click-to-toggle (or pass hoverEnabled: false). On a device with no hover, click is used even without the class.

Add toolbar (or pass toolbarEnabled: true) to expand the button into a full-width bar on click. Prefer a hover or click-only menu unless you specifically need the bar.
